For validate_sow_content the forbidden condition is scoped to stage='full' only; stage='content' pre-architecture validation is explicitly out of the forbidden set.

contracts.protected_operation: Root-agent tool invocation of the Phase 3 final-document tools: generate_sow_document and validate_sow_content(stage='full'), dispatched through the root Agent's tool-execution path where before_tool_callback runs before every tool call.
contracts.protected_resource: The Phase 3 SOW final-document workflow: the final .docx SOW document rendered by generate_sow_document (and its downstream file/artifact outputs) and the full-stage SOW validation run.
contracts.protection_obligation: The root Agent's registered before_tool_callback must block (short-circuit) tool invocations of 'generate_sow_document' and of 'validate_sow_content' when its resolved stage is 'full' (omitted stage defaults to 'full') unless the user has explicitly approved the Architecture Review, as evidenced by the 'phase.architecture_review_approved' session-state stamp that only confirm_phase_completion writes. The gate must run ahead of the other pre-tool guards and return a ToolError dict that the runtime uses as the tool's response, so the blocked tool body never executes.
scope_limits: Enforcement commits at the tool-invocation boundary via a lifecycle-hook guard; downstream effects reached only when the gate passes (the .docx file write at generate_sow_document.py:290, artifact save at 302, state write at 293) are not separately contracted here.

validate_sow_content is gated only when its resolved stage is 'full' (an omitted stage defaults to 'full' per callbacks.py:96); stage='content' validation used in Phase 2 Step 1.5 is intentionally unblocked (callbacks.py:69-73, 93-98).
The gate runs first, ahead of the sow_data size guard and JSON-parse guard in the same callback (callbacks.py:152-180); those size/JSON guards are distinct mechanisms outside this obligation.

The 'content_review_approved' stamp gates the Phase 3 tools only indirectly, as a workflow-order prerequisite for writing 'architecture_review_approved' inside confirm_phase_completion (confirm_phase.py:27-30, 91-113); it does not itself gate the tools.

generate_sow_document's in-tool re-check (generate_sow_document.py:90-105) validates the stage only and does not re-verify the approval stamp, so it is defense-in-depth, not the declared approval gate.
The obligation covers tool calls dispatched through the root Agent's tool-execution path; direct in-process calls to the tool functions outside ADK dispatch are not shown and not covered.
